description: OONI reported that its tests began showing signs of restrictions on Discord in Türkiye on October 8, 2024. Compare the measurements around that date with the Russia case.
OONI reported that Discord was blocked in Russia starting October 8, 2024. The testing volume and types of results vary by day.
Canadian tests for the same window as the October 2024 cases in Türkiye and Russia, for comparison.
A month of tests targeting the Cairo cinema Zawya’s website, with gaps on days for which OONI returned no measurements.
A rolling view of tests targeting Discord from Canadian networks. Sparse or missing dates reflect OONI’s coverage, with results drawn only from networks on which tests ran.
